mutations.name: Promise.all stops at the first rejection instead of settling every child
mutations.replace: children.map(async (child): Promise<AllOutcome<T>> => ({ ok: true, value: await child })),
kills: a red child does not cancel its siblings: both siblings complete and the red one is reported

mutations.name: a red step is rethrown instead of reported
mutations.find: if (error instanceof StepFailedError && !isAuthorityStop(error)) return { ok: false, red: error };
kills: a red child does not cancel its siblings: both siblings complete and the red one is reported

mutations.name: a non-step error is rethrown before the siblings settle
kills: a recovery-required child is rethrown only after the other children settle

mutations.name: an authority refusal or denial is reported red instead of rethrown
mutations.find: return error instanceof AuthorityRefusedError || error instanceof AuthorityDeniedError;
kills: an authority-refused child is rethrown, not reported red, after the other children settle
an authority-denied child is rethrown, not reported red, after the other children settle
